title: Certified GitOps Associate (CGOA)
releaseBlockers: fluxcd.io's footer says All Rights Reserved while its docs repositories are Apache 2.0: confirm the licence before release
description: CGOA: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: the OpenGitOps documents, the CNCF glossary and the Argo CD and Flux docs

checks.what: One independent audit read all 249 cards against the OpenGitOps documents, CNCF glossary and Argo CD and Flux docs they quote, found word for word by the card checker, including every YAML and command snippet
checks.result: No wrong answers. Three cards that contradicted each other on Flux's reconciliation interval fixed; the configuration-as-code primer cut back to what its source says; 13 cards that repeated KCNA or Argo cards or each other deleted and 4 rewritten as new GitOps scenarios; 3 ambiguous cards and 2 unclear ones fixed.
